items.name: Racker
items.summary: Our name for the point guard. Shown as 1 in our diagrams.
keys: First objective: RACK IT. Beat everyone to the rim.
Coast to coast or off an outlet
Initiate the Offense

items.name: Locks
items.summary: Usually our 2 and 3. Locks live in the corners.
keys: SPRINT to the corners at the start of every offensive possession
Stay LOCKED in the corner until you're involved in an action

items.name: Dragon
items.summary: Usually a 4, or someone who gets downhill well. Shown as 5 in our diagrams. Our inbounder and trailer.
keys: ALWAYS INBOUNDS THE BALL, NO MATTER WHAT, IN ALL SITUATIONS
DRAGS behind the play as the trailer
Stays available for the Racker
Can initiate triggers

items.name: Rabbit
items.summary: Our big, shown as 4 in our diagrams. Sprints the center lane in transition and works between 8 spots in the half court.
keys: Transition: SPRINT the center lane to the rabbit hole (either block)
Half court spots: each dunker spot, each block, each elbow, the nail and the top of the key

items.name: Power
items.summary: 1 at the top, 4 and 5 at the elbows, 2 and 3 in the corners. Our base look for half-court sets.
keys: Elbows sit at the free-throw line extended, not below it
Corners stay in the corner until the ball moves
1 brings it to the top with a live dribble

items.name: 4-Out
items.summary: Four out, one in. Racker and Dragon in the slots, Locks in both corners, Rabbit on the block.
keys: Racker (1): left slot with the ball
Dragon (5): right slot, the trailer
Locks (2 and 3): LOCKED in the corners
Rabbit (4): ball-side block

items.name: 5-Out
items.summary: All five outside the arc: top, both wings, both corners. Opens the lane for drives, cuts and paint touches.
keys: 15 to 18 feet between teammates
Wings set at the free-throw line extended
Fill the spot a cutter leaves

items.name: Twirl
items.summary: Our ball screen (PNR), set by the Rabbit. The Rabbit rolls. Twirl and Get are interchangeable.
keys: Called on its own, Twirl runs on the ball side with whoever has the ball and the Rabbit
Ball handler: get to the nail to simulate the drive, then swing it to the other slot
Screener: sprint in, wide base, hold until contact
Handler: set your man up first, then go shoulder to hip
Screener rolls on the handler's second dribble
Handler reads the big's defender: hedge = pocket pass, drop = pull-up
reads: They switch → screener seals the smaller man and posts
Help comes from the corner → kick to the corner
Big's man jumps out high → reject the screen and go the other way

items.name: Rub
items.summary: A DHO to the ball-side guard. The ball handler dribbles at the ball-side Lock, the Lock comes up to take the handoff, and the handler fills the corner. Goes into a Twirl or Get.
keys: Whoever hands the ball off fills to the corner
Backside: down screen away from the ball to keep the defense engaged, unless we came out of a trigger (its down screen is the backside action)
Next: Twirl or Get with the Rabbit

items.name: Twist
items.summary: Pass from the slot to the Lock. The passer rides up the lane line and fills the corner, and the Lock fills the slot with the ball. Goes into a Twirl or Get.
keys: Passer: ride up the lane line and fill the corner
Lock: fill the slot with the ball
Backside: down screen away from the ball to keep the defense engaged, unless we came out of a trigger (its down screen is the backside action)
Next: Twirl or Get with the Rabbit

items.name: Zoom
items.summary: A down screen into a handoff (Rub).

items.name: Pirate
items.summary: Iso post up.

items.name: Swing
items.summary: A pass that switches sides: slot to slot, continuing the direction the ball was moving.
keys: Usually slot to slot
From a wing or corner: to the first man on the other side (a same-side pass is a Kick)
Keep going the same direction the ball was moving

items.name: Skip
items.summary: Skip pass, usually from one side to the other. The pass skips a perimeter player and goes to the next one.
keys: If there's no one to skip to, there's no skip
Skip to a Lock: the Lock rises with the ball
The player who was skipped runs the lane line and fills back to the corner
Out of a drive: across to the weak-side corner or the open man; the driver spaces back out

items.name: Back to You
items.summary: Pass it back to the player who passed it to you.

items.name: Get
items.summary: Pass into a DHO (Rub) back to the passer, run with the Rabbit. Twirl and Get are interchangeable.
keys: Rabbit: flash to the ball-side elbow if you're not there
Pass to the Rabbit, then go get it back
Ball handler: get to the nail to simulate the drive, then swing it to the other slot
Rabbit: hand it back, then roll to the rim

items.name: Post Entry
items.summary: Post entry pass to the nearest teammate in the paint.

items.name: Continuity
items.summary: When added to the call bar, the actions keep repeating, moving the ball side to side when they can.
keys: Repeats the actions only. Triggers like 5 Thru don't repeat.
Rub and Twist run their backside down screen on each repeat
Run it keeps the possession going until you pause

items.name: Drive
items.summary: Attack the paint off the dribble. On the whiteboard he drives left, the way Lock Left forces him, so you can see our help: Wall steps up, Bear fills, Gap snipes and grabs.
keys: Get to the edge of the paint
Eyes up for the kick

items.name: Kick
items.summary: A same-side pass: slot to corner, wing to corner, or out of a drive to the open shooter on that side.
keys: Same side of the floor
Out of a drive: the driver spaces back out

items.name: 5 THRU
items.summary: 5 runs through to the left wing and down-screens for 3. 3 comes off the screen toward the sideline to the left slot: backside action to keep the defense engaged away from the ball.
keys: Step 1: 5 runs through from the right side to the left wing and down-screens for 3. 1 dribbles over to the right wing. 4 flashes from the left block to the right elbow.
Step 2: 3 comes off the screen toward the sideline to the left slot. Backside action to keep the defense engaged away from the ball. The ball stays with 1.
The Thru's down screen is our backside action. Going into a Rub or Twist, no extra backside screen.

items.name: 1 THRU
items.summary: 1 swings it to 5, then runs through and down-screens for 2. 2 comes off the screen toward the sideline to the right slot: backside action to keep the defense engaged away from the ball.
keys: Step 1: 1 passes to 5 on the right side. 4 crosses the lane to the right block.
Step 2: 1 runs through and down-screens for 2 in the right corner. 5 dribbles back to the left wing. 4 flashes to the left elbow.
Step 3: 2 comes off the screen toward the sideline to the right slot. Backside action to keep the defense engaged away from the ball. The ball stays with 5.
The Thru's down screen is our backside action. Going into a Rub or Twist, no extra backside screen.

items.name: Pitch
items.summary: The Racker hands the ball off to the Dragon at the top of the key, right into actions.
keys: Racker: dribble at the top and hand it off to the Dragon
Dragon: come over the top of the Racker, take it on his outside shoulder and turn the corner downhill
Racker: then down-screen for the Lock on the side the Dragon came from; the Lock comes off toward the sideline to the slot and the Racker replaces to the corner
Its down screen is our backside action. Going into a Rub or Twist, no extra backside screen.
Right into actions

items.name: Switch
items.summary: Or Swing Pitch. The Racker swings it to the Dragon, the Dragon comes over and pitches it back to the Racker at the top of the key, right into actions.
keys: Racker: swing it to the Dragon, then come back over the top of him, take it on his outside shoulder and turn the corner downhill
Dragon: come over and pitch it back to the Racker
Dragon: then down-screen for the Lock on the side the Racker came from; the Lock comes off toward the sideline to the slot and the Dragon replaces to the corner
Its down screen is our backside action. Going into a Rub or Twist, no extra backside screen.
Right into actions

items.name: Power Zoom
items.summary: From Power, 1 swings it to 4 and cuts through, then we run Zoom: 5 down-screens for 3, and 3 comes off it into a handoff from 4 and attacks the rim.
keys: Step 1: 1 dribbles to the left wing. 3 lifts out of the corner.
Step 2: 1 passes to 4 at the right elbow and cuts through to the right corner. 2 runs the baseline to the left corner.
Step 3: 5 down-screens for 3. 4 dribbles at 3 and hands it off (Rub).
Step 4: 3 attacks the rim. 5 dives to the baseline. 4 spaces to the left wing.

items.name: Lock Left
items.summary: Our defensive system. A style of defense centered around forcing offenses LEFT, with the goal of them making decisions and passes using their left hand.
keys: NO RIGHT HAND DRIVES
NO OPEN CATCH AND SHOOT THREES

items.name: Advantage Basketball
items.summary: Once we create an advantage — we beat a man, or the defense has to help — the next action has to keep it. Drive, kick, swing. Don't hold it.
keys: Catch with your feet ready to shoot, drive or pass
Make your decision in half a second
A good shot now beats a great shot later only if the advantage is gone

items.name: Paint Touch Before a Three
items.summary: Get the ball into the paint, by a drive or a post feed, before we take a three. Kick-out threes are our best threes.
keys: Drive or post feed first
Exception: a wide-open catch-and-shoot in transition

items.name: Sprint Back, Talk Early
items.summary: When the shot goes up, the guards sprint back. Stop the ball, protect the rim, then match up. Everyone talks.
keys: First back takes the rim
Second back stops the ball
Point and call out who you have

items.name: On Ball Shade
items.summary: The on-ball defender is ALWAYS forcing the ball to JAIL (the left corner).

items.name: Gnaw
items.summary: On-ball pressure, staying connected to the hip even when beaten by a step.

items.name: Attack the Hip
items.summary: On closeouts we are always attacking the ball handler's RIGHT HIP (the defender's left), with active high hands for deflections in the passing lanes and contests on shots.

items.name: Wolf
items.summary: Wolf is the defender pressuring the point guard full court and making them bring it up on the left side.

items.name: Tiger
items.summary: Tiger is the secondary press defender, usually guarding the inbounder. Also forcing the ball to cross half court on the left.

items.name: Snipe and Grab
items.summary: Defensive term for stunting off ball and trying to steal the kick-out on a drive.

items.name: Scram
items.summary: SWITCH. Usually in transition or deficit situations.

items.name: Gap
items.summary: The Gap defender is the first off-ball defender to the left, sitting in the GAP between the driving lane and the passing lane, looking to snipe and grab.

items.name: Deny
items.summary: The Deny defender is the first off-ball defender to the right, hard denying any pass to the right and keeping the ball on the left side.

items.name: Wall
items.summary: Wall is the paint help defender. As soon as they see a drive, they sprint to help OUTSIDE OF THE PAINT. Active hands and WALLING UP, staying on our feet.

items.name: Bear
items.summary: The drop defender in help, filling the space left by the WALL going over to help on a drive.

items.name: Hard Hedge
items.summary: Any ball screen going RIGHT: the screener's man HARD HEDGES, jumping out to force the ball back LEFT, and the ball defender fights OVER the screen to get back to him. No switch.
keys: Big: jump out hard into his path, then recover to the roller
On-ball: fight over the top of the screen and get back in front
The roll-side corner defender tags the roller until the big gets back
Beat the hedge (he keeps going right): the on-ball and the big recover, the roll-side corner tags the roller

items.name: Drop / Contain
items.summary: Any ball screen going LEFT: the ball defender FORCES him INTO the screen and the big plays DROP / CONTAIN, staying between the ball and the rim. No switch.
keys: On-ball: force him into the screen, then chase over the top on his back hip
Big: drop, between the ball and the rim and in front of the roller

items.name: Kick
items.summary: A same-side pass: the ball stays on the side of the floor it's on.
keys: On the whiteboard: Kick

items.name: Swing Pass
items.summary: A pass that switches the ball from one side of the floor to the other.
keys: Usually slot to slot
Makes the defense move with the ball (the string)
On the whiteboard: Swing

items.name: Lift
items.summary: The corner player moves up to the wing when the ball is driven baseline.

items.name: Drift
items.summary: Slide along the arc away from a middle drive so you stay in the driver's sight line.
